hcontainer.p: (14) Under the EU-U.S. DPF, this is ensured through different Principles. Firstly, under the Data Integrity and Purpose Limitation Principle, similarly as under Article 5(1)(b) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679, an organisation may not process personal data in a way that is incompatible with the purpose for which it was originally collected or subsequently authorised by the data subject (27).
